briefs.body: Close the BmAK HUD unknowns that block the build. Read Research/BatmobileGrab/HUD.md, HUD_SPEC.json and the carved movies listed in HUD_INVENTORY.json, decompiled with FFDec in E:/Modding/_shared/tools/ffdec. Settle each of these from bytes: how many frames the Cap Decrease label lasts; what text argument the damage-number setter takes; what the child clip ch1040 is; the pixel size of every radar icon symbol; the three BoostCooldown tier values (tier 0 is 12.0 s, find tiers 1 and 2). Write Research/BatmobileGrab/HUD_UNKNOWNS.md with one row per question: answer, the AS3 or tag evidence, or the word UNKNOWN when the movie does not say. Add a --check script Tools/scripts/hud_unknowns.py that re-derives each number. Done when the script exits 0 and no row lacks evidence. Operator fact: no speedometer; do not spend time on it. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

Two read-only decodes. First, in the JC3 HUD scripts exported from ui/hud.gfx (see Research/JC3Grab/JC3_HUD_WEAPONS.md for the export folder), decode hud_code/poi.as: where the icon label is placed, how the Update call advances sub-frames, and what delivers m_CurrentType. Second, build a disposition table for all 25 BmAK RHudModule classes in Research/BatmobileGrab/HUD_INVENTORY.json: for each, one of use, replace-with-JC3-closest, or drop-because-operator-says-absent, with the closest JC3 system named and the gap stated (never write that JC3 has no system). Only Batmobile, Targets, Radar, Health, Scanner and Alerts are expected to matter. Output Research/JC3Grab/POI_DECODE.md and Working/HUD/MODULE_DISPOSITION.md. Done when 25 of 25 modules have a row and every claim cites a file and line. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

The writer half of a modified ui/hud.gfx is answered by reports/hud-gfx-ffdec-roundtrip.md; the loader half is not. Do the offline part of it. Using ffdec -dumpSWF, compare tag types and versions of the BmAK movies (carved from the UPKs per HUD_INVENTORY.json) against the JC3 ui/hud.gfx, listing every tag or AVM2 feature present in one and absent in the other. Then answer from files only: can a HUD movie be chosen per vehicle, or is ui/hud.gfx one global movie (cite RJ names lines about hud.gfx references and the payload tree Builds/probe-L0/P3-hud-gfx)? Write Working/HUD/LOADER_COMPAT.md with a table: question, offline answer, what only a game take can settle, and the exact one-line observation for that take. Done when every row has evidence or UNKNOWN, with no guesses about Scaleform behaviour. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

Bring the HUD translation ledger in line with the operator facts. Read Working/Translation/T6_HUD_CAMERA.md, OPERATOR_PRIORITIES.md, reports/hud-cluster-closest-system-plan.md section 10 and reports/hud-radar-dash-plans-v2.md. Apply these changes as appended rows to Working/Translation/T_ROWS.jsonl (never rewrite old lines): T-HUD1 becomes suppress the speedometer inside the Batmobile; the badge row becomes map; armour overlay is dropped because the operator describes one health bar; add new rows for health top-left in battle, afterburner gauge left in pursuit, the cooldown gauge left of it, and radar class icons. For the second cooldown gauge write down what BmAK has (the native boost cooldown) and what the gap is. Output Working/Translation/HUD_LEDGER_V3.md listing each row id, old text, new text, evidence. Done when t19_hud.py --check and hud_spec.py --check still pass. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

BmAK HUD placement is authored for a 1024 by 720 stage (the cluster maths used 1024 by 768); the target is a 1280 by 720 viewport and also fractions of the viewport for the hook overlay. Derive the coordinates once. From Working/HUD/CLUSTER.json, Research/BatmobileGrab/HUD_SPEC.json and Research/BatmobileGrab/HUD_UNKNOWNS.md, produce Working/HUD/LAYOUT_1280x720.json: for each element (health bar, boost meter, cooldown gauge, radar, weapon slots, reticle, lock marker) give pixel x, y, width, height at 1280 by 720, the same as fractions, and the scaling rule used (letterbox, stretch, or anchor-to-edge) with the evidence for it. Add Tools/scripts/hud_layout.py --check that recomputes every row. Done when the check exits 0 and the health bar lands near the (32.8, 55.7) target of hud-radar-dash-plans-v2.md. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

Several HUD rows were closed as out even though the project rule forbids concluding that JC3 has no system. Re-open them. Read the out rows in Working/Translation/T6_HUD_CAMERA.md lines 25 to 29 (battle overlay, winch meter, energy system, combo and medals, occupants) and reports/remote-control-range-static-overlay-plan.md (halted). For each, state whether the operator's play facts (ROADMAP.md section 7, memory bmak-gameplay-facts) say the element exists. If yes, name the closest JC3 HUD or POI system, the gap, and what a build must add; if no, record the operator fact that removes it. Output Working/Translation/HUD_OUT_ROWS_REOPENED.md with a decision per row and the file lines behind it. Done when every out row has either a closest-system plan or a cited operator fact, and no row says JC3 has no system. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

Gadget selection HUD for the Batmobile. Read reports/gadget-wheel-input-plan.md, Research/BatmobileGrab/HUD.md section 8 (RadialGadgetSelect pairing unconfirmed) and the hold-LT and gadget facts in ROADMAP.md section 7. Confirm from the decompiled movie whether RadialGadgetSelect is the module that BmAK's gadget wheel uses: list its setters and frame labels. Then map it to the closest JC3 radial or weapon-select HUD in the JC3 scripts and state the gap. Write Working/HUD/GADGET_WHEEL.md with the setter table, which gadgets the Batmobile shows per mode, and the drawing spec for the hook overlay of brief 7985 as the fallback if hud.gfx cannot be edited (use Working/HUD/LOADER_COMPAT.md for that decision). Done when the module pairing is stated as confirmed or UNKNOWN with the evidence. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

Turn the Vulcan crosshair capture analysis into numbers a build can use. Input: reports/vulcan-capture-frame-timing.md, reports/vulcan-capture-fire-and-overheat-timing.md, and the movie facts in Research/BatmobileGrab/HUD_SPEC.json (accuracy frame labels). The operator saw the crosshair spread while firing, turn red, and never lock out. Write Working/HUD/VULCAN_RETICLE.md giving: spread radius in screen fractions at rest and at full bloom, seconds to full bloom, seconds to recover after release, the colour change point, and the formula for the JC3 UpdateWeaponReticle reticle_size argument as well as for an overlay. Mark every number that came from the capture versus the movie. Where the scale is unknown, say UNKNOWN and name the one measurement a game take must make. Done when each number carries its frame range or file line. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

Two drawing specs for the overlay of brief 7985. One: the 60 mm cannon reload circle, a 0 to 1 cooldown arc swept through 360 degrees over the reload time (reports/cannon-60mm-reload-circle-plan.md; take the reload seconds from the decoded weapon values, not memory). Two: the tracker marker, yellow while the target is tracked and grey when the signal is lost, with a distance string, weakening with range and visible through walls (reports/tracker-lock-hud-plan.md, operator facts in ROADMAP.md section 7). Give for each: anchor, radius, stroke width, colours as RGB from the movie, the value that drives it, and the JC3 POI types 19 and 24 as the alternative route. Output Working/HUD/CANNON_TRACKER_SPEC.md. Done when the spec names the source file and line of every colour and number, or UNKNOWN. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

Radar needs a per-frame vehicle to marker driver, and the movie contains zero vehicle CreatePoi calls. Decide the route from evidence. Inputs: reports/radar-icon-set-extract.md, reports/radar-minimap-icon-plan.md section 8, the 7982 telemetry report for what the hook can read per entity, and the 7985 overlay report. Compare route a (hook draws the radar icons itself) and route b (hook feeds JC3 POIs to a modified hud.gfx), per icon class: cops, military, tracked, hacked red to green, tank (larger), helicopter (spinning blades). For each class state the state source (the hacked flag comes from brief 9108's SAM hack) and the accuracy cost, e.g. the eight-way m_ArrowState versus continuous bearing. Output Working/HUD/RADAR_ROUTE.md ending in one chosen route with reasons. Done when all six classes have a source or UNKNOWN. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

The HUD must show the afterburner gauge in pursuit and the health bar in battle, and nothing yet tells it which mode is active. Find out what can. Read reports/hook-live-vehicle-readout.md and the mode swap report from brief 7984, Research/JC3Grab/JC3_HUD_WEAPONS.md section 7, and reports/hud-cluster-closest-system-plan.md U2 and U4. List every source of a mode flag: the hook's own mode variable, the entity's m_CurrentType delivery, or the donor nitro and weapon components that make stock code push InitVehicleNitrous or UpdateVehicleWeapons. For each, give whether it works for the hook overlay and for a gfx edit, plus the one read a game take must make. Output Working/HUD/MODE_SIGNAL.md. Done when each source is marked evidenced or UNKNOWN with a file citation. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

Review pass over the HUD grab and translation wave. Re-read the reports of the briefs that produced Research/BatmobileGrab/HUD_UNKNOWNS.md, Research/JC3Grab/POI_DECODE.md, Working/HUD/LOADER_COMPAT.md, Working/Translation/HUD_LEDGER_V3.md, Working/HUD/LAYOUT_1280x720.json, Working/Translation/HUD_OUT_ROWS_REOPENED.md, Working/HUD/GADGET_WHEEL.md and Working/HUD/VULCAN_RETICLE.md. List every fact that changed a plan assumption (for instance the loader answer, any icon size, any UNKNOWN that turned into a number). Then open the later HUD queue briefs in tmp/freebuff/queue/ that have not started (the files whose report does not yet exist and that concern hud, radar, lock, reticle, health bar, afterburner, speedometer) and edit their text so they cite the new numbers and drop questions already answered. Do not touch started briefs. Write the change list to reports/review-hud-grab-wave.md. Done when each edited brief is named with before and after of the changed sentence. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

Hide JC3's speedometer only while the player is in the Batmobile. Start with the five-minute probe design: MCI_speedo.visible set false, compared on the Batmobile and a vanilla car (reports/dash-hud-unknown-closing.md N23). Read Working/HUD/LOADER_COMPAT.md and Working/HUD/MODE_SIGNAL.md to pick the route: an AS3 edit in a private ui/hud.gfx tree, or a hook-side call from the overlay of brief 7985. Build the chosen route under Builds/hud-speedo/ with a receipt listing each changed byte range or hook symbol, and a one-line revert note. Operator fact: no speedometer appears anywhere in the Batmobile. Do not install anything in the game folder. Done when the receipt exists, the file parses (ffdec round trip or a compile check), and a script Tools/scripts/hud_speedo_check.py --check confirms the vanilla path is untouched. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

Author the radar icon set. Use the icon extract of reports/radar-icon-set-extract.md and the pixel sizes in Research/BatmobileGrab/HUD_UNKNOWNS.md. Produce six icons and their atlas entry: cops, military, tracked in green, hacked in red and its green twin, an enlarged tank arrow, and a helicopter arrow with blades as a rotating frame set. Render them as PNG sprites plus, if the route file Working/HUD/RADAR_ROUTE.md picked hud.gfx, SVG shapes ready for an ffdec import. Place them in Builds/hud-radar/ with a manifest.json holding name, size, colour hex and source symbol. Operator fact: most icons are arrows pointing where the vehicle faces. Done when manifest.json lists all eight sprites and a script Tools/scripts/hud_radar_assets.py --check confirms each file exists and has the stated size. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

Build the reticle layer of the hook overlay, from the specs. Inputs: reports/lock-markers-spec.md (battle orange diamond that appears instantly; pursuit shrinking circle inside an edge-gapped diamond), Working/HUD/VULCAN_RETICLE.md, Working/HUD/CANNON_TRACKER_SPEC.md and the overlay structure from the 7985 report. Implement drawing code and fixtures under Builds/hook-0006/ (new tree, not hook-0005): functions for the two lock markers, the Vulcan crosshair with bloom and red shift, the cannon reload arc and the tracker marker, each taking plain numbers so they can be tested without the game. Provide a golden-image test: render each at three input values to PNG and store them with hashes. Lock progress comes from MissileLockOnDuration of brief 9105. Done when the golden PNGs exist for all four elements and a check script exits 0. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

Weapon slot content and the four visible slots. Read reports/four-weapon-slot-build-plan.md B8, the output of brief 9160 (reports/rc5-hud-build.md) and Working/HUD/LOADER_COMPAT.md. For the four Batmobile weapons per mode give names, icon ids (602, 603, 618, 619; boost badge 614) and the rule that infiniteAmmo=true hides the counters. MCI_vehicle_weapons2 and 3 are hard-sized to two slots in the movie, so decide, from the loader answer, between extending the movie and drawing slots 3 and 4 from the hook overlay. Build the chosen part in Builds/bm-RC5-hud-slots/ with rc5_hud_slots.py --write and --check, plus a branch record under Working/RC5/branches/ using the format in reports/rc5-scaffold-and-merge-script.md. Done when the check lists four slots with name, icon and counter state for each mode and every edited file parses. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

Damage number and hit marker. From Research/BatmobileGrab/HUD_UNKNOWNS.md take the decoded setter signature (part, amount, duration, frames), and from Research/BatmobileGrab/HUD_SPEC.json the frame labels. Check ROADMAP.md section 7 before building: the operator says the Batmobile takes no crash damage and shows no damage stages, so decide whether numbers appear on the player's own vehicle at all; if the operator facts say they only appear on targets, build only that. Write the spec and a minimal implementation (hook overlay text draw or the gfx text tag edit proven in Builds/probe-L0/P3-hud-gfx) under Builds/hud-dmg/, with the screen position derived from Working/HUD/LAYOUT_1280x720.json or marked UNKNOWN. Done when the receipt lists each field's source and a check script confirms the parse. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

Review pass over the HUD build wave. Re-read the reports for the speedometer suppression, radar assets, lock marker overlay, weapon slot content, damage number, radar route decision, mode signal census and cannon/tracker spec briefs. Note every place where a build contradicts another (for example a build assuming hud.gfx editing while the loader report says global-only) and every figure that changed. Then edit the text of the not-yet-started HUD verify, pilot and test briefs in tmp/freebuff/queue/ so their checks, card names and pass bands match what was actually built; leave started briefs alone. Record the edits in reports/review-hud-build-wave.md with before and after sentences, and flag any element whose route changed from gfx to overlay or back. Done when the report lists each edited queue file and no later brief still names an abandoned route. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

Offline verification of every HUD build. Run, from E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile, each of: Tools/scripts/bmak_hud_cluster.py, hud_spec.py --check, bmak_speedometer.py --check, t19_hud.py --check, hud_radar_recheck.py, bm_rc4.py, v03_wiring.py, plus the new checks hud_layout.py, hud_radar_assets.py, hud_speedo_check.py, rc5_hud.py --check and rc5_hud_slots.py --check, and a parse of every edited hud.gfx via ffdec. Record the exit code and the first failing line of each. For each of the operator's seven HUD leads (health top-left in battle, afterburner gauge left in pursuit with cooldown gauge, no speedometer, radar icon set, lock diamond and circle, cannon reload circle, Vulcan bloom) state which build file implements it and which check proves the file side. Output reports/hud-offline-verify.md. Done when each of the seven leads has an implementing file or a stated gap. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

Write the HUD pilot cards in the format of Working/Q/PILOT/CARD_FORMAT.md, one file per card in Working/Q/PILOT/: HUD_REST.md, HUD_BATTLE_HEALTH.md, HUD_PURSUIT_BOOST.md, HUD_SPEEDO_HIDDEN.md, HUD_RADAR_ICONS.md, HUD_LOCK_MARKERS.md, HUD_VULCAN_CANNON.md. Each card has: the setup spawn (use SPAWN_BATMOBILE.md, ENTER_EXIT.md and CONTROLS.md steps by name), one observation, the pass rule with numbers from the build (boost ring 12.0 s plus or minus 0.3, eight arrow headings, tank arrow larger, helicopter distinct from the arrow, speedometer absent versus a vanilla car), the screenshot or recording instruction from SCREENSHOT.md and RECORD.md, and the fix-card route on fail naming the build brief to re-open. Done when the seven files exist and a grep shows each has the four headed parts. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

In-game test, agent-piloted under operator supervision, only after the operator approves. Install the private hud.gfx tree from Builds/bm-RC5-hud or Builds/hud-speedo into a copy only as the console-thingy install flow allows, using cards Working/Q/PILOT/HUD_SPEEDO_HIDDEN.md and HUD_REST.md. One observation: does the game load the modified hud.gfx at all, and is the vanilla speedometer hidden on foot-to-car and in the Batmobile only? Pass rule: the changed text or element shows in the HUD, no crash within three minutes, speedometer absent in the Batmobile and present in a vanilla car. Save a screenshot and the log tail. On fail, write a fix card in Working/Q/ naming the loader row in Working/HUD/LOADER_COMPAT.md and mark the gfx route abandoned in the report. Write reports/hud-gfx-load-gate.md. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

In-game test of the hook overlay, agent-piloted, operator-approved only. Use cards HUD_BATTLE_HEALTH.md and HUD_PURSUIT_BOOST.md in Working/Q/PILOT/ plus the hook-0005 install notes from the 7985 report. One observation: with the overlay on, does the health bar sit top-left in battle mode, and does the afterburner gauge sit on the left in pursuit mode with its cooldown gauge to its left? Pass rule: both positions within 5 percent of Working/HUD/LAYOUT_1280x720.json, boost ring empties in about 2.0 s and refills in 12.0 s plus or minus 0.3, no gauge in the wrong mode. Record a short clip and a timing table. Fail route: write a fix card in Working/Q/ naming the 7985 build file and the layout row. Write reports/hud-test-overlay-health-boost.md. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

In-game test, agent-piloted, operator-approved only. Use cards HUD_RADAR_ICONS.md, HUD_LOCK_MARKERS.md and HUD_VULCAN_CANNON.md from Working/Q/PILOT/. Three observations, each recorded: (1) radar shows eight arrow headings, a bigger tank arrow and a distinct helicopter icon; (2) in battle an orange diamond appears at once on a target and in pursuit a circle shrinks inside the gapped diamond over about 2 s; (3) the Vulcan crosshair spreads then reddens and the cannon reload arc sweeps once per shot. Pass rule: each matches its golden image from Builds/hook-0006 by eye and timing within 0.3 s. On fail write a fix card per element naming the build brief. Write reports/hud-test-radar-lock-reticle.md with screenshot paths. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

Release notes and safeguards for the HUD. Read Working/Installer/install_v3.ps1, Working/HUD/LOADER_COMPAT.md and the gate test report reports/hud-gfx-load-gate.md. Answer: if the chosen route replaces ui/hud.gfx globally, what changes for every vehicle and for on-foot play; how does the installer back up and restore the original; what is the install size added; and which route gives the least collateral (overlay versus gfx). Draft the HUD part of the user README and the changelog line in Working/Installer/HUD_RELEASE_NOTES.md and write a rollback check script description (do not edit install_v3.ps1; list the exact lines to add). Done when the notes name the chosen route, the rollback steps and the measured size, each with a file citation. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

Camera loose ends, offline. One: apply Working/Translation/T_CAM2_PROPOSAL.md as an appended ledger row, and settle the cameras-per-mode boost value (67.7 against 72.49 vertical) in reports/cameras-per-mode-plan.md section 4. Two: read the configs not yet read, BatmobileConversationCamConfig and RidingCarCamFOV, in Research/BatmobileGrab/CAMERA.md data, and decide whether a bonnet or cockpit camera exists for the Batmobile; state the closest JC3 camera for each. Three: write how the FOV conversion changes for aspect ratios other than 16:9. Output Working/Camera/CAM_LOOSE_ENDS.md with a row per item (answer, evidence, UNKNOWN where the files are silent). Done when Tools/scripts/bmak_camfile.py check still reports 8 of 8 and no row is missing evidence. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

One CCameraRef per entity means a battle camera, a boost camera and a chase-2 preset need a switching route. Plan it. Read Working/Camera/CAM_REF.md, reports/cameras-per-mode-plan.md and the mode swap report of 7984. List the candidate routes: a second tune applied by the mode pair of brief 9130, a hook call that swaps the CCameraRef at runtime, or a variant entity; mark which are evidenced. Also write the closest-system plan for head impulse (0.5), drift orientation (0.15) and airborne smoothing, naming what the nearest GenericVehicleCamera members are and the gap. Output Working/Camera/CAM_SWITCH_PLAN.md with a recommended route and the single probe that would confirm it. Done when each of T-CAM8 and NEW-CAM-2 and NEW-CAM-3 has a recommended route or UNKNOWN with a probe. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

Build the battle camera tunes. Values from reports/cameras-per-mode-plan.md section 4: battle position [0,2.05,13.50], look-at [0,0.05,0], FOV 36 degrees both ends (BmAK 60 horizontal), rigid pivot; battle with winch [0,4.05,12.50]; anti-personnel 40 horizontal. Use Tools/scripts/bmak_camfile.py to write extra .ctunec files beside bat_base.ctunec in a new tree Builds/bm-RC5-camera/, without touching the RC4 files, and add the entity or mode reference the route in Working/Camera/CAM_SWITCH_PLAN.md recommends. Do not invent a unit conversion: reuse the vertical FOV formula already in T_CAM2_PROPOSAL.md. Add a script rc5_camera.py with --write and --check and a branch record under Working/RC5/branches/. Done when the check reads back every value from the written files and 8 of 8 base values are unchanged. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

The camera shake needs an ADF writer that can append a new type and instance, while Tools/scripts/bmak_camfile.py only rewrites existing rows. Prototype that writer on a copy. Study Tools/scripts/jc3adf.py and the .ctunec layout in Working/Camera/CAM_TUNE.json; pick one shipped .ctunec as the test file. Write Tools/scripts/adf_append.py that appends one instance of an already present type first (a second instance of the tune struct), then, if that round trips, a type the file does not yet contain, copying it from a donor ADF. Prove by reading the result back with jc3adf.py and by byte-diff that nothing else moved. Work only in Builds/adf-append/ and mark any offset table, hash table or size field you had to rewrite. Done when both append cases parse and a diff report shows only the intended regions changed, or the failing case is named. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

Author the camera shake. With the appended-type writer from the previous brief (Tools/scripts/adf_append.py) put a CameraShakeModifierParams instance into a copy of the Batmobile .ctunec in Builds/bm-RC5-camera/. Values: BmAK boost shake 35 and wheelspin shake 50 by 50 by 25 over 0.1 s (Research/BatmobileGrab/CAMERA.md); do not convert units by guess. Read reports/cameras-per-mode-plan.md section 6 steps 1 to 3 and the JC3 shipped shake instances (Working/Camera/CAM_REF.md) to find what the JC3 numbers mean, and list each value you could not map as UNKNOWN with a check for a game take. Done when jc3adf.py reads the new instance and the shake members hold the stated source numbers, a report lists mapped and UNKNOWN fields, and the RC4 camera files are unchanged by hash. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

Operator fact (memory bmak-gameplay-facts): in battle mode the nose swings toward where the camera points. Camera-side specification. Read reports/rc5-drive-modes-and-yaw.md from brief 9122, the camera yaw members in Working/Camera/CAM_REF.md and Research/BatmobileGrab/CAMERA.md. State where the yaw target comes from (camera forward vector), how the hook or the handling tune receives it, the rate at which the nose follows (use the decoded battle yaw rate, otherwise UNKNOWN), and what a pilot observes. Output Working/Camera/YAW_COUPLING.md including the camera quantity the hook must read and the exact observation for a test card. Done when the quantity, source symbol or UNKNOWN, rate and observation are each stated with a citation. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

Two special camera states. The chasing takedown camera (position [0,-2,25], 80 degrees horizontal, default pitch -65.9 degrees, which is not a JC3 member) and the remote-control view. Read reports/cameras-per-mode-plan.md, Working/Translation/HUD_OUT_ROWS_REOPENED.md and reports/remote-control-range-static-overlay-plan.md. For each, name the closest GenericVehicleCamera or hook-controlled camera route from Working/Camera/CAM_SWITCH_PLAN.md, state the gap, and list the fields a build must set, with a value from BmAK or UNKNOWN. Check ROADMAP.md section 7 for whether the operator confirmed either state exists. Output Working/Camera/SPECIAL_CAMERAS.md. Done when both states have a verdict (build, or removed by a cited operator fact) and a probe. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

Verify the camera wiring after the entity rebuild. In the tree produced by brief 9101 and in Builds/bm-RC5-camera/, confirm the CarCameraRef of every Batmobile entity points at the bat_base tune (or the battle tune where intended), the 2-byte .epe rename is intact, and the RC4 camera values are unchanged: run Tools/scripts/bmak_camfile.py check and compare hashes.
